def test_ext_bar_block_adds_colors_block_and_preserves_comments():
        """Externalized from: legacy/test/test.coffee::"Bar block" tests
    
        Original internal behaviors (mkConfig(theme, bar_block)):
          - Adds a `colors {}` block inside `bar {}` if missing/empty
          - Preserves bar comments/directives (e.g. '# @bar_comment@', 'verbose true')
          - Adds bar colors into `bar { colors { ... } }`
          - Adds window client colors at end of config
    
        Upward trace (CLI reachability):
          main() -> validate_config_or_exit() -> validate_config() -> Command('i3 -C -c <config>')
          main() -> writer::write_config(config, None, theme) when no -o/-s
            Inputs: `-c <config>` and `<theme>` as positional arg.
    
        Downward trace (observability):
          writer::write_config(..., output=None, ...) prints rewritten config to stdout.
          We assert on stdout for preserved lines + injected color lines.

            td = Path(td)
